question: Should OpenClaw adopt `safetyDiagnostics.emit()` plus manifest-declared `safetyEventTypes` as a permanent plugin SDK contract for operator safety telemetry?
rationale: This is a new extensibility and provenance boundary, not a mechanical implementation detail; maintainers must choose its long-term ownership, supported event set, and external-plugin policy.

options.title: Approve and narrow the contract
options.body: Approve a documented minimal event set, provenance semantics, retention policy, and compatibility tests before this API becomes public.

options.title: Keep telemetry core-only for now
options.body: Defer plugin emission and observer APIs, retaining only any maintainer-approved internal diagnostics needed for current core boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve and narrow the contract
recommendation.body: Approve a documented minimal event set, provenance semantics, retention policy, and compatibility tests before this API becomes public.
